reviews.text: not understanding this app at all - there's no option to make an account, and clicking forget password just makes a clicking sound. it doesn't even open a page or anything. I just downloaded it so it doesn't need to be updated. are you supposed to sign up on a separate website and then come to the app? if I have to go to multiple different sites or apps to set up an account for something that is supposed to make running my business easier, I'm just gonna get another paper planner like....??
Worked very well for my company. I could sugguest some UI upgrades and enhancements, but for the most part this app works very well.

GPS works 70% of the time to map walks. App has been super buggy the last few months-- unable to open/load app to close services, unable to open/load app to start services, and randomly zeroing out services WHILE they occur.
Can you please make it so I can make appointments and also apply discounts for when I have sales thanks
i cant even login to the app. dont reccomend

It's a decent app, but everytime I open the app I get 2 notifications that I have walks that were closed offline. If i try to clear the notifications they instantly happen again. Usually when that happens you close and open the app and it stops. It has been 6 months(started in September). Deleting the app and re-downloading it doesn't help, updating doesn't help, I just have unending alerts from this app. It is unbearable. App has been updated and now I need push notifications f this app.

App gets the job basically done, but is always glitching. I have to delete and redownload at least once a day which is absurd. The notifications, which I've seen other people have a problem with, are unnecessary and maddening. I don't use the mapping function because I think it would give me even more issue. Don't dare click out of the visit to check on something or you'll have to start the timer over again completely. This app need A LOT of work. 5/23/23 app not doesn't work at all!

Incessant notifications for appointments completed offline. Generally, we're happy with Scout for our business, but the fact that I've been having these false notifications for about a year now on multiple devices, and still no resolution, is incredibly frustrating.

If you can't register than how do you use it? I downloaded this app bc my dog sitting pay was getting eaten up by rover's greedy 20% take. Well the app opens to a sign in page, where obviously you can't sign in bc you were never given the option to sign up. Who makes these pointless apps and then just leaves them for people to waste their time on?

Having major issues with not showing walks completed when there is poor reception. The app USED to give a notice and would shoe walk completed when cell service area improved. Now it's gives a notice Nd then changes walk back to unwalked

Hi! Leaving a review to also say this app is for business owners to manage their appointments and goes hand in hand with the online Scout Platform, where appointments are managed, invoices created, etc. This is NOT an app like Rover or Wag! It is a tool to be used in conjunction with the online Scout platform for independant businesses. Please do not leave them a one starr review if you do not understand the purpose of the app! The Scout team is amazing, and Im very satisfied with this app

NOTE: Please understand Scout is NOT a gig app like Rover or Wag- it is a tool for pet business owners to manage operations and billing. I've been using the Scout platform for 2 years now and it has completely changed my day to day for the better! I have more time in my day to speak to clients, more time for appointments, and I don't know how I would keep track of staff schedules without it. Makes billing so much easier! Customer support is stellar!!!
No option to create an account

So I downloaded then realized I couldnt sign up, scrolled through reviews and saw the company said to go to their website because they dont offer sign ups on their app for some reason. I went to the website to sign up and it wont let me start an account.. click 'sign up' and nothing happens.

I am confused about this app, because I have to obtain an account to sign in but there's no way to get one. So how are people using this app? Please make a way to have an account and I'll give this app more stars.

Scout is great and really helps make customers feel at ease, definitely something that makes me stand out as a walker. It's also an easy transition for customers that have used or currently use Wag/Rover. Also the management team is very quick to respond and super helpful. Constantly trying to help as much as possible!

I've used the app for a week now and I find it to be great! I think it's pretty easy to set up and use. The cost is reasonable . The support has been great as well. Rich has been very responsive when I had questions. The one thing that would make it perfect is if there was a way to track mileage, but I'm pleased so far.
Excellent customer service! Helped me with a start up issue until it was solved. They communicated and followed up. Good job!
App is super user friendly! It's very clean looking and my clients love their pets report card feature!
Some issues with schedule not appearing. Hopefully issues are resolved by this update.
It didn't let me sign in after I downloaded it ):
reviews.reply:
Hi, this app is part of the Scout platform -- there currently isn't a way to sign up as a business through the app. However, you can do so by going to https://app.scoutforpets.com/signup.

Thank you!

reviews.text: This app has been great so far. It still has a few kinks to iron out and they're still implementing many options, but the support is nothing short of fantastic. The interface is very straight-forward and clean.
reviews.reply: Hi, Kavin! We certainly appreciate the positive review. We're working hard to iron out those kinks :) Thank you for your patience! Let us know if we can help with anything else.
